x: H. Pascoe, who has had a very successful season in Open Mile Handicaps, having gained a place in each one held, finished third just in front of Bryan.
Quite a big field turned out in the 1 Mile, including M. Bingham, H.

For the 1 Mile we were especially pleased to welcome none other than Len Herbert, our Club Champion, who was home on leave, and he showed that he had lost none of his old form by winning in the very creditable time of 4 min. 35.2 secs. Les Cohen gained second place for the South, with H.
